definitions.gloss: elementary school (level or years); primary school
definitions.explanation: The elementary-school level or years, almost always used in compounds such as {小学校|しょうがっこう} (elementary school) and {小学生|しょうがくせい} (elementary-school pupil). Parallel to {中学|ちゅうがく} (middle school) and {大学|だいがく} (university).

examples.japanese: {小学|しょうがく}{一年|いちねん}になる。
examples.english: to enter the first year of elementary school

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{小学|しょうがく}{三年生|さんねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My daughter is a third-year elementary-school student.

examples.japanese: {小学|しょうがく}から{中学|ちゅうがく}に{上|あ}がると、{勉強|べんきょう}の{内容|ないよう}が{急|きゅう}に{難|むずか}しくなる。
examples.english: When you move up from elementary school to middle school, the schoolwork suddenly gets harder.

notes:
Almost always used in compounds rather than on its own: {小学校|しょうがっこう} (elementary school), {小学生|しょうがくせい} (elementary pupil), {小学|しょうがく}{一年|いちねん} (first grade). Parallel to {中学|ちゅうがく} and {大学|だいがく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小学校|しょうがっこう}: elementary school
- {小学生|しょうがくせい}: elementary-school pupil
- {小学|しょうがく}{低学年|ていがくねん}: lower elementary grades

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中学|ちゅうがく}: middle school — the next level up
- {小学校|しょうがっこう}: the school institution itself (full form)
